If your clients are in healthcare or enterprise, and they need any of these capabilities, a Kleza partnership makes you more valuable to them without adding internal overhead.</p>
        <p>We keep our partner programme simple. No complex accreditation tiers. No annual quotas. Just a shared interest in delivering better outcomes for the organisations we both serve.</p>

<!-- ===== SECTION 07 — FAQ ===== -->
<section class="pt-faq-sec" data-screen-label="FAQ">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="pt-faq-head"><span class="eyebrow">FAQ</span><h2>Partnership questions, <span class="ital">answered.</span></h2></div>
    <div class="pt-faq">
      <div class="pt-faq-item"><button class="pt-faq-q" type="button">What types of partnerships does Kleza offer?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="pt-faq-a"><p>Kleza offers three partnership types: Technology Partnerships for software and platform vendors, Referral Partnerships for consultants and agencies, and Reseller Partnerships for managed service providers and digital agencies who want to offer Kleza services to their own clients.</p></div></div>
      <div class="pt-faq-item"><button class="pt-faq-q" type="button">Is there a cost to becoming a Kleza partner?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="pt-faq-a"><p>No. There is no fee to join the Kleza partner programme. Partnership arrangements are structured around mutual value &mdash; referral fees, co-marketing, or reseller pricing &mdash; depending on the partnership type.</p></div></div>
      <div class="pt-faq-item"><button class="pt-faq-q" type="button">Does Kleza partner with organisations outside healthcare?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="pt-faq-a"><p>Yes. While 75% of our client base is in healthcare, our Enterprise Services and AI Services serve retail, legal, finance, and professional services organisations. Partners in any of these sectors are welcome to apply.</p></div></div>
      <div class="pt-faq-item"><button class="pt-faq-q" type="button">How do I apply to become a partner?<span class="plus">+</span></button><div class="pt-faq-a"><p>Complete the short application form on this page and choose the partnership type that fits your organisation. We review every application personally, and if there&rsquo;s a fit you&rsquo;ll hear from us within 3 business days.</p></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

(function(){
  /* FAQ accordion */
  document.querySelectorAll('.pt-faq-q').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click',function(){ btn.parentElement.classList.toggle('open'); });
  });

  /* Pre-select partnership type from a tier "Apply" link */
  var typeSel=document.getElementById('pf-type');
  document.querySelectorAll('.pt-apply[data-tier]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var t=a.getAttribute('data-tier');
      if(typeSel){ for(var i=0;i<typeSel.options.length;i++){ if(typeSel.options[i].value===t||typeSel.options[i].text===t){ typeSel.selectedIndex=i; break; } } }
    });
  });

  /* Application form — inline validation + success state */
  var form=document.getElementById('ptForm');
  var success=document.getElementById('ptSuccess');
  function setErr(name,msg){
    var el=form.querySelector('.pt-err[data-for="'+name+'"]');
    if(el) el.textContent=msg||'';
  }
  function isEmail(v){ return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v); }
  if(form){
    form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      if(form.company_url && form.company_url.value){ return; } /* honeypot */
      var ok=true;
      ['name','organisation','email','type','about'].forEach(function(n){ setErr(n,''); });
      if(!form.name.value.trim()){ setErr('name','Please tell us your name.'); ok=false; }
      if(!form.organisation.value.trim()){ setErr('organisation','Please add your organisation name.'); ok=false; }
      if(!isEmail(form.email.value.trim())){ setErr('email','Please enter a valid email address.'); ok=false; }
      if(!form.type.value){ setErr('type','Please choose a partnership type.'); ok=false; }
      if(form.about.value.trim().length<200){ setErr('about','Please share at least 200 characters about the partnership.'); ok=false; }
      if(!ok) return;
      form.style.display='none';
      if(success) success.classList.add('show');
      if(success) success.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});
    });
  }
})();
